# We're starting a Substack


### Clear your inboxes and get your pixels together


[Daniel Farrell](https://substack.com/@danielfarrell)


Apr 02, 2024


If you’re a designer, product manager, frontend engineer, design engineer, or just want to hear a different approach to building a startup, you’ll want to smash the subscribe button. It’ll be a good time – we’ll do our best to keep it interesting!


We’ll be sharing our progress, learnings, and updates here along the way, so subscribe to get the latest from Kiet and Daniel at Onlook!
